## Clustering

```{r}
DefaultAssay(VD2_cells) = "Protein"
resolutions = c(0.3,0.4, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0,1.4)

VD2_cells = FindNeighbors(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "adt_harmony_vd2",
  dims = 1:19
)

for (r in resolutions) {
  VD2_cells = FindClusters(
    VD2_cells,
    resolution = r,
    algorithm = 1 #louvain
  )
}

```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
library(patchwork)

plots = lapply(
  resolutions,
  function(r) {
    DimPlot(
      VD2_cells,
      reduction = "adt_umap_vd2",
      group.by = paste0("Protein_snn_res.", r),
      label = TRUE
    ) + ggtitle(paste("res =", r))
  }
)

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)

ggsave("ADT_clusters_0.3_until_1.4_ADT_UMAP.pdf", height = 10, width=8)

```

```{r}
adt_res_col = paste0("Protein_snn_res.", "0.3")

#remap 0->1 and 1->2
VD2_cells$ADT_clusters = as.character(VD2_cells[[adt_res_col]][[1]])
VD2_cells$ADT_clusters[VD2_cells$ADT_clusters == "1"] = "2"
VD2_cells$ADT_clusters[VD2_cells$ADT_clusters == "0"] = "1"


VD2_cells$ADT_clusters = as.factor(VD2_cells$ADT_clusters)

DimPlot(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "adt_umap_vd2",
  group.by = "ADT_clusters", 
  label = TRUE
) +  
  ggtitle("ADT Clusters (Res 0.3)") +
  labs(x = "ADT UMAP 1", y = "ADT UMAP 2")

ggsave("ADT_clusters_1-2_UMAP.pdf", height = 5, width = 6)
```

## clustering rna



## chosen cluster
```{r cluster_relabel}
## 1-indexed cluster labels
VD2_cells$ADT_cluster = factor(
  as.integer(as.character(VD2_cells$Protein_snn_res.0.3)) + 1
)

n_clusters = nlevels(VD2_cells$ADT_cluster)
cluster_levels = levels(VD2_cells$ADT_cluster)

cluster_of_interest = "2"

## Colorblind-friendly palette with Cluster 4 emphasized
base_colors = c(
  "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "#E69F00",  # orange
  "#CC79A7",  # purple
  "#0072B2",  # blue
  "#F0E442",  # yellow
  "#999999"   # grey
)

other_clusters = setdiff(cluster_levels, cluster_of_interest)

cluster_palette = setNames(rep(NA, n_clusters), cluster_levels)
cluster_palette[other_clusters] = base_colors[seq_along(other_clusters)]

cluster_palette[cluster_of_interest] = "#E4002B"

cluster_palette
```


```{r fig4a_umap_clusters_relabeled1, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
DimPlot(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "adt_umap_vd2",
  group.by = "ADT_cluster",
  label = TRUE,
  cols = cluster_palette
) +
  labs(x = "ADT-based UMAP 1", y = "ADT-based UMAP 2", colour = "Cluster") +
  ggtitle("Figure 4A: ADT-based clusters (res = 0.4)")
```

```{r fig4a_umap_clusters_relabeled, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
DimPlot(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "adt_umap_vd2",
  group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5",
  label = TRUE
) +
  labs(x = "ADT-based UMAP 1", y = "ADT-based UMAP 2")
```


```{r fig, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
DimPlot(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "rna_umap_vd2",
  group.by = "Protein_snn_res.0.3",
  label = TRUE
) +
  labs(x = "RNA-based UMAP 1", y = "RNA-based UMAP 2") + ggtitle("ADT cluster overlaid on the RNA-based UMAP")
```



```{r}

rna_col <- "RNA_snn_res.0.5"       
adt_col <- "Protein_snn_res.0.3"   

# row 1: colored by RNA clusters on both UMAP embeddings
p1 <- DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "rna_umap_vd2", group.by = rna_col, label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("RNA Clusters on RNA UMAP") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p2 <- DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_umap_vd2", group.by = rna_col, label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("RNA Clusters on ADT UMAP") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# row 2: colored by ADT clusters on both UMAP embeddings
p3 <- DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "rna_umap_vd2", group.by = adt_col, label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("ADT Clusters on RNA UMAP") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p4 <- DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_umap_vd2", group.by = adt_col, label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("ADT Clusters on ADT UMAP") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

 #Combine into a 2x2 grid and save
grid_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)
grid_plot

ggsave("RNA_vs_ADT_UMAP_comparison_14-09-2026_17-09-2026.pdf", plot = grid_plot, width = 14, height = 10)


```

```{r}

cluster_contingency <- table(RNA = VD2_cells@meta.data[[rna_col]], 
                             ADT = VD2_cells@meta.data[[adt_col]])

write.csv(cluster_contingency, "RNA_vs_ADT_cluster_cross_tabulation_17-09-2026_ohne_3280-1.csv")

pheatmap(log1p(cluster_contingency), 
         main = "Overlap between RNA and ADT Clusters (log1p cell counts)",
         filename = "RNA_vs_ADT_cluster_heatmap_17-09-2026_ohne_3280-1.png")
```
